en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a town square bordered by two‑ to three‑storey buildings with gabled roofs and shopfronts at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk across the cobblestoned market square; a lamppost and small monument or fountain are in the center. Red German script at the bottom identifies the view as a market square in Geringswalde, seen from the south side, and a publisher credit appears along the lower margin.
